#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@a17a2e2e2d69dd60ce3c8460985e621cb28060f9
    with:
      runtime_ref: a17a2e2e2d69dd60ce3c8460985e621cb28060f9

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@a17a2e2e2d69dd60ce3c8460985e621cb28060f9
    with:
      runtime_ref: a17a2e2e2d69dd60ce3c8460985e621cb28060f9
      issue_number: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}

Need game: 2d horse racing game, a single game cycle consisting of 5 events and 3 races. Like Uma Musume. Phone/tablet. Need build playable. Need likely artful. Need own screenshots. We can use Canvas 2D. Need design comprehensive.

Let's plan.

Game concept: "Sakura Stride" horse racing training/racing game. Single cycle: 5 events (training events) and 3 races. Like Uma Musume career mode. Need playable on phone/tablet, responsive, touch. We should make full game in HTML/CSS/JS, likely no build deps. Need 5 events with choices that train stats; 3 races where you tap rhythm/boost and watch. A career over weeks. We can implement:

- Title screen
- Career hub with horse, stats (Speed, Stamina, Power, Guts, Wit), energy/fans, schedule.
- 5 events: probably story event cards with multiple choices affecting stats/energy/mood; each event then advances to a race or next event. Sequence perhaps Event 1 -> Race 1 -> Event 2 -> Event 3 -> Race 2 -> Event 4 -> Event 5 -> Race 3 (Finale). Single game cycle 5 events 3 races. Each race is playable with mechanic.
- Races: auto-runner 2D side view; tap/click at rhythm "surge" zones or hold to sprint. Could have a stamina bar, speed. Player taps to build acceleration (tap burst) and hold? Need compelling. Simple: two controls: tap "Go" in green zones? Uma-like race mostly auto with skill activation. We can do interactive race: "Surge" meter and timing bar. A continuously moving slider; tap when marker in highlighted zone to activate boost; each successful gives speed burst and fans. Also can pace "Reserve" vs "Sprint" with buttons? On tablet.

Maybe race gameplay:
- Horse runs automatically along track with progress; AI rivals move with speeds.
- Player has stamina that drains faster when sprinting. A rhythm bar at bottom with rotating needle. Tap anywhere/space when needle crosses a colored "surge zone" to gain burst; perfect = big burst. 
- Two buttons: "Pace" (hold to sprint using stamina) and "Skill" (once meter full). But touch at same time? Could use tap "surge" and hold right side? Simpler mobile.

Alternative timing bar with tap at green zone and stamina management choice every so often. Need intuitive.

Let's design race:
- Viewport landscape preferred on phone/tablet but responsive for portrait too. Could prompt rotate? Better support both using CSS layout adapt. Canvas fills panel.
- Race lasts ~35s? 3 races, 5 events, total 4-6 mins. Keep cycle ~4 min. Race can be 20-30 sec each.
- Player pink horse (CSS/canvas drawn) in 2D side view; 5 horses. Draw stylized horses via canvas shapes? Could be challenging but doable. Use emoji 🐎? Aesthetic maybe not good. Canvas vector horse with running animation could be nice, with mane/colors, silks. Or sprite-like cartoon horse with circles/ellipses. We can draw side profile: body ellipse, neck, head, four legs animated sine, tail, jockey with helmet. Track with parallax hills, crowd. Should look polished.

- Canvas at DPR resolution; scene scaling.
- Race simulation with length 1000m, racers; positions normalized. Camera follows pack, draw 5 lanes (horizontal rows) side-scrolling. Perspective? 2D side with lanes y. Track ~40% screen. Sky gradient, grandstand, infield.
- Each racer: progress meters. Player stats affect base speed/stamina.
- Rivals have names, colors, base pace.
- Distance markers, finish line, leaderboard maybe small top line.
- Speed/stamina model: target pace based on race stage, stamina spend. Player taps at rhythm to trigger "kick". Need skill.
- Race UI bottom overlay: progress? Timing meter (horizontal bar with moving cursor) and controls.
- Use tap anywhere in canvas or big "SURGE" button. Cursor oscillates in meter. Green zones. Tap in green: boost; perfect center. Miss: small penalty. Every e.g. 1.8 sec cycle.
- Maybe hold-to-sprint button: hold increases speed and stamina drain. But tapping is enough. Could add "Hold to push" with stamina. Hmm, Uma Musume races are automatic with skills. For game feel, rhythm taps.

Better race mechanic: "Rhythm gallop":
- A pulse bar with moving cursor and sweet spot. Tap to hit. Consecutive hits create "stride" multiplier and build "Spirit" meter. At 100%, auto activates "Blaze" boost for 4s. Player can strategically press "Boost" once or twice depending on stamina anyway.
- Stamina decreases over race; if depleted, speed drops. Hitting good notes restores tiny stamina? So skill matters.
- Opponents' speeds designed so player must hit ~most notes to win but can lose. Need races outcomes to influence story; still full cycle playable even if loses. Three race difficulty tiers.
- Race results rewards fans, maybe stat boosts and event choices. Need retry? Could allow race replay? Single cycle maybe no. To ensure full playable, final result screen after 3 races.

- Events: 5 scenes with choices:
  1. "Dawn at Aoi Ranch" pick training: speed/stamina/power etc.
  2. "The Crowded Market" fan event, choose engage crowd vs focus.
  3. "Rival's Challenge" choose response.
  4. "Rainy Day Practice" choose method.
  5. "The Night Before the Final" choose dinner/rest, etc.
Choices modify stats, mood/energy. Maybe plot names.

Sequence: Opening -> Event 1 -> Race 1 "Hanami Sprint" (1200m) -> Event 2 -> Event 3 -> Race 2 "Riverbend Derby" (1800m) -> Event 4 -> Event 5 -> Race 3 "Grand Starlight Cup" (2400m). That matches 5 events, 3 races.

- UI career screen between events with schedule timeline 8 nodes and "Next" button; show horse card and stats.
- Story scenes full screen with illustrated backdrop (CSS art, maybe canvas background or gradient), portrait horse avatar, dialogue, 3 choices. Click choice -> reveal outcome and stat diffs, then Continue. Touch accessible.
- Training choices do stats. Use 0-100 stats; race simulation uses stats. Need ensure choices meaningful.

- Audio? WebAudio procedural music? Could add optional sound, but no assets. We can synthesize light hoofbeat, crowd, chimes, and background music. Autoplay constraints: audio unlocked on user gesture. Could implement simple SFX only with mute toggle. Background music maybe procedural loop too complex; could do jaunty 8-bit-ish piano with WebAudio. Nice but not needed; polish. Let's include minimal ambient crowd noise and SFX with mute.

- Local storage for best career? Could add. Not necessary. But maybe "memories" collection? Keep scope.

- Visual style: Uma Musume inspired but original. "Trackside Tales" / "Starlight Derby". Use cream/pink Japanese-inspired aesthetic, cherry blossoms. Horse girls? 2D horse racing with horses. Could have jockey/horse anime-ish. Keep original "Starlight Stride". Main horse "Hoshizora" (Star) + trainer. Rival "Midnight Bell". We'll use horse portraits as emoji? Use canvas art avatar? Could draw horse face in CSS using emoji not elegant. Create inline SVG for mascot/crest. Use SVG illustrations for horse portrait and scenes maybe.

Could build UI with custom fonts from Google? Network maybe unavailable in screenshots; better system fonts ("Georgia", "Trebuchet MS", etc.) or use @import? Don't rely on network. Stylistic serif heading with Georgia and rounded sans (Trebuchet MS). For anime vibe use gradients, glass panels, stars, petals via CSS/JS.

Need test identity. Need know default-start. Let's inspect runtime scripts.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

let browser
try {

    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })

    const start = await startForCapture(page, {

      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)

      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }
